name: BACH_0350
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (85%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Tier 3: OOD quality and 90% conformal set spanning Benign and InSitu [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 85%, Benign 9%, Invasive 7% | Favors InSitu; low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% coverage) | Cannot separate InSitu vs Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability; 100th OOD percentile [F6] | Suspect input; out of distribution |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False | Foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 2/5 (40%) InSitu [F5] | Weak support; Benign nearest |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 1, 2) · ↓ invasive · High score (-0.751) lowers invasion risk [F2] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 8) · context · Below-typical score; descriptive only [F3] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Low score (-0.451) lowers invasion risk [F4] · Validated
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 2, 6, 8) · context · 91% neoplastic (100th percentile) [F7]; 4019/mm² (97th) [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; top-3 risk deletion beats random (+0.011, 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unverified (CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), mitoses (0/20) Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Artifact caused OOD flag, or unreliable necrosis (3/20) falsely separated Benign case BACH_0330.
- Invasion exists in regions 6, 5, or 8, matching Invasive neighbors BACH_0138, BACH_0079.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 2**: Confirm duct confinement vs hyperplasia; consider drafted ER, CK5/6, deeper levels.
2. **Regions 6, 5, 8**: Inspect top risk zones (260 tumor nuclei in 6, TILs [F9]) for invasion.
3. **Regions 3, 5, 10**: Check true necrosis (Unreliable, 3/20) vs artifact; consider drafted recut H&E.
